text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
“—Even if I'm told to look to the right,
I won't do it unless I'm convinced.”

text_block_list.name: Prestigious Club Trainer
text_block_list.text:
I told you that chasing from behind has an inconsistent win rate,
didn't I? Why did you drop back on your own?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
With a personality like that, my compatibility with
"mentors" had been terrible since way back when.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Running freely and seizing victory.
That place is nothing more and nothing less than that.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Win rates aren't freedom.
I don't want to be tied down on the turf—

text_block_list.name: Prestigious Club Trainer
text_block_list.text:
But what if... you end up losing
because of that carefree freedom?

text_block_list.name: Prestigious Club Trainer
text_block_list.text: ...Please don't let all that talent go to waste.

Today is the memorable first day where training
for the Twinkle Series finally begins!
Mr. C.B. is—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ――Haha, ...ahahaha!!

Kicking off the ground, cutting through the wind,
breathtakingly free and fluid,
at an unrivaled speed—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Taaaahhhhh!!!
Racing through the freestyle track.
After searching everywhere for her when she failed to appear for training, I finally found her at this spot where heated unofficial races take place, but—

Overwhelmed by the brilliance of her running,
I forgot what I was searching for and simply watched in awe.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Aaah, dammit!! Lost again!
You're so fast, C.B.!

The opponent is... Katsuragi Ace.
An Umamusume from the countryside, burning with fighting spirit
to become a true "Ace."
Despite being in the same generation, she seems to hold a deep admiration for Mr. C.B.—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Ace was really fired up today too.
I somehow got swept up in the energy myself!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Heheh, I just got all fired up!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
...And. Huh, Trainer!
What are you doing in a place like this?
choice_data_list: No, it's just that you didn't show up for training...
No, it's just that you didn't show up for training...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ah.
You're right, it's time for training!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: It completely slipped my mind. Sorry, I'll be more careful next time.

"...Forgetting about training
is unacceptable. However—"

She is...
you could say an Umamusume who lives to run.

It's quite possible she got carried away and forgot.
...In fact, for her,
the training is probably just a bonus.
I simply reiterated that she should be careful from now on, and—
Mr. C.B. tilted her head in surprise.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: You're not going to get mad at me?
choice_data_list: Because I believe racing is more important than anything.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
...I see.
You really are the kind of person who'd say that.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Still, somehow,
it still feels a little strange.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
People in your position usually give you
an earful if you just do whatever you want.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: CB-san!!!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
!
Um... Who are you guys...?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
I was watching that race just now!
That was seriously insane!
That speed, that springiness! Absolutely wicked!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Right, right?! C.B. is just so amazing.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: No seriously... I'm like, insanely excited for this!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: If it's CB-san, she could become the third Triple Crown Umamusume in history... No, she might even surpass that Umamusume known as the "Myth"...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
That's true!
If it's you, CB-san, I'm sure you can do it!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: A "myth," huh.

—Once upon a time,
there was an Umamusume hailed as a "myth."

An Umamusume boasting overwhelming strength with 15 wins out of 19 races,
but what is remembered above all else...
is her achievement of the Classic Triple Crown.
An honor that only two runners in Twinkle Series history have ever managed to achieve.

No one has achieved it since her—
and whispers are beginning to spread that perhaps
no one ever will again.
"Winning all three Classic Triple Crown races was just that difficult, and the record and impact she left behind were truly the stuff of 'myth.'"
Being expected to surpass a 'myth' could be seen as the highest form of praise for an Umamusume, but...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ...I'm not really interested, I guess.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Hah!?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Of course, I know how amazing she is.
If someone's aiming for that, I want to cheer them on,
and I have no intention of making fun of anyone's dream.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"...Still,
when it comes to races, I want to run free."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: B-But—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, you guys.
Don't pry too much.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: No, but wait! T-Trainer, are you seriously okay with this!? With C.B. acting like this!

To her, racing wasn't about
glory or crowns.

That was something she made sure to tell me herself
before we officially signed a contract
as trainer and trainee.
choice_data_list: Just being able to see you run freely is enough for me
Just getting to see you run freely is enough for me.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: I mean, look.

Though looking somewhat taken aback,
the Umamusume on the track
didn't say anything further.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Thanks for earlier, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: I was so happy that you—

text_block_list.name: Prestigious Club Trainer
text_block_list.text: ...Please don't let all that talent go to waste.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ...For protecting that place for me.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! That's all. Well then!
I'm off!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Huh? A walk!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Doesn't matter.
When the mood strikes, it's time for a walk.
Leaving me standing there dumbfounded, Mr. C.B. started walking lightly down the sunset-lit path—
On a whim, I turn around.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: It starts from here! I can't wait, Trainer!

"...And so began the days of
racing through the Twinkle Series
alongside Mr. C.B."
